body.subIssue: Funds not received from closed account
body.narrative:
My account was closed and I was not notified of this action. After over 5 calls was finally told they needed to verify account.

Account was verified over 3 different times. 

Them I was told the company owner of my deposited check for {$1000.00} needed to call and verify information. 

XXXX XXXX and XXXX XXXX called TWICE ( they are also family members ) They verified check information and cleared checked dates. 

Called several more times and I get the run around from customer service to fraudulent dept. They can not release my funds without their authorization No proof of fraud No proof as to why account was closed Will not send me my funds {$2200.00} I need HELP
